model_result.answer_summary: 120 arrangements: 6! = 720 bijective assignments of six distinct functional groups to the six primary CH2OH sites of alpha-CD, divided by the 6 rotations of the macrocycle (free action because all six groups are distinct; no reflection symmetry since alpha-CD is chiral), giving 720/6 = 5! = 120.
model_result.final_theorem_statement: Fintype.card Arrangement = 120, where Arrangement is the quotient of addressed patterns (ZMod 6 ≃ Fin 6) by the rotation action of Multiplicative (ZMod 6).
assumptions: alpha-CD contains exactly six alpha-D-glucopyranoside units, hence six CH2OH modification sites arranged on a 6-site cyclic array (problem text, Q9 preamble).
hexadifferentiated means the six sites carry six distinct functional groups (context of Q9-8, compound S).
arrangements are counted up to rotation of the macrocycle only; alpha-CD is chiral (all-D-glucose), so reflection produces the enantiomer, a different molecule, and is not quotiented out.
standard chemistry knowledge used: cyclodextrin macrocyclic topology and chirality of D-glucose-derived cyclooligosaccharides.
